name: citadel-ts
description: TypeScript -> Luau toolchain for Minefort Citadel packs. `npm run build` transpiles src/ to dist/ (dist IS the pack folder: upload it). Types in types/citadel.d.ts are GENERATED from the official Citadel docs — regenerate with `npm run dts`. Conventions: members with this: void are dot calls, others are colon calls; callbacks take arrow functions.
